name: Proto-Dialga
look: a Dialga of glowing blue crystal veined in cyan and flecked with stars, silver armour round a glowing chest diamond and long striped crystal blades fanning from its shoulders like wings
entry: A Pokémon resembling Dialga, described in an ancient star chart as a dragon of living crystal that walked the mountaintops when time was young. The night sky moves within its body.
how: Wild: very rare at dawn on mountain peaks.
